# gruvbox theme inputs

Source: https://github.com/lonre/gruvbox-intellij-theme

Commit: `715762987c6f91735ad4b08d5cf852ab49b2215a`

License: MIT (`LICENSE`). Exact upstream bytes and hashes are recorded in assets.tsv.

Original author fields are preserved. If absent, use upstream vendor credit: Lonre Wang.

- `gruvbox_dark_medium.theme.json`: Gruvbox Dark Medium (`gruvbox-dark-medium`); old names: Gruvbox Islands Dark Medium
- `gruvbox_dark_soft.theme.json`: Gruvbox Dark Soft (`gruvbox-dark-soft`); old names: Gruvbox Islands Dark Soft
- `gruvbox_dark_hard.theme.json`: Gruvbox Dark Hard (`gruvbox-dark-hard`); old names: Gruvbox Islands Dark Hard
- `gruvbox_light_medium.theme.json`: Gruvbox Light Medium (`gruvbox-light-medium`); old names: Gruvbox Islands Light Medium
- `gruvbox_light_soft.theme.json`: Gruvbox Light Soft (`gruvbox-light-soft`); old names: Gruvbox Islands Light Soft
- `gruvbox_light_hard.theme.json`: Gruvbox Light Hard (`gruvbox-light-hard`); old names: Gruvbox Islands Light Hard
